simulationInfo.integratedModelDescription: A 0D research and education model integrating ventricular interaction, systemic and pulmonary circulation, coronary circulation, and cardiac rhythm.
simulationInfo.validationDescription: Current automated checks cover finite numerical values, blood-volume conservation, and event consistency. They do not establish physiological or clinical validity.
simulationInfo.baselineIndexedVolumesDetail: Valve-closure EDVI/ESVI indexed to BSA 1.9 m². Required range: {{range}}. Exact equivalence to an imaging modality is not claimed.
simulationInfo.baselineIndexedFlowDetail: Native aortic forward flow indexed to BSA 1.9 m². Required range: {{range}}.
simulationInfo.baselineAorticPressureDetail: Completed-beat Ao-node maximum/minimum. Required range: {{range}}. Exact equivalence to peripheral brachial pressure or a waveform with reflections is not claimed.
simulationInfo.baselinePulmonaryPressureDetail: Completed-beat PAP maximum/minimum, mean RAP (CVP), and mean LAP (PCWP* surrogate). Required range: {{range}}. *A wedged catheter is not modeled.
simulationInfo.baselineLvDpDtDetail: Accepted-step intracavitary LVP rate. Reference corridor: {{range}}. These provisional construction bounds do not independently establish physiological invalidity; the result depends on heart rate, load, and time step.
simulationInfo.baselineRvDpDtDetail: Accepted-step intracavitary RVP rate. Reference corridor: {{range}}. These provisional construction bounds do not independently establish physiological invalidity and are not equivalent to TR Doppler estimates.
simulationInfo.baselineHistoricalLvDpDtDetail: Accepted-step intracavitary LVP rate. Required corridor in this historical baseline assessment: {{range}}. This preserves the original construction decision, not a universal clinical normal range.
simulationInfo.baselineHistoricalRvDpDtDetail: Accepted-step intracavitary RVP rate. Required corridor in this historical baseline assessment: {{range}}. This preserves the original construction decision, not a universal clinical normal range or TR Doppler estimate.
simulationInfo.baselineBidirectionalPassed: Passed at low and high volume
simulationInfo.baselinePreloadReserveDetail: Fixed-control formal period-1 settlement at −{{low}}% / +{{high}}% TBV. Output falls on the low-volume side (LV {{lowLv}} / RV {{lowRv}}) and rises on the high-volume side (LV {{highLv}} / RV {{highRv}} L/min). The direction-specific required criteria for output change, pressure–flow slope, and EDV response are satisfied. This is not validation of a clinical fluid challenge.
simulationInfo.baselinePreloadReserveDetailStandard69: Fixed-control formal period-1 settlement at −{{low}}% / +{{high}}% TBV. Output falls on the low-volume side (LV {{lowLv}} / RV {{lowRv}}) and rises on the high-volume side (LV {{highLv}} / RV {{highRv}} L/min). Standard69 adds floors of ≥3% CO change, ≥0.02 L/min/mmHg CO/filling-pressure slope, and ≥3% EDV change in each direction for both ventricles. These post-exploration construction non-regression floors are not validation of a clinical fluid challenge.
simulationInfo.baselinePreloadReserveDetailStandard70: Fixed-control formal period-1 settlement at −{{low}}% / +{{high}}% TBV. Output falls on the low-volume side (LV {{lowLv}} / RV {{lowRv}}) and rises on the high-volume side (LV {{highLv}} / RV {{highRv}} L/min). Standard70 re-admits floors of ≥3% CO change, ≥0.02 L/min/mmHg CO/filling-pressure slope, and ≥3% EDV change in each direction for both ventricles. These construction non-regression floors are not validation of a clinical fluid challenge.
simulationInfo.baselineTransmuralResponseDetail: Maximum-volume ED transmural pressure falls at low volume (LV {{lowLv}} / RV {{lowRv}} mmHg) and rises at high volume (LV {{highLv}} / RV {{highRv}} mmHg). EDV is required to move in the same direction.

modelLimitations.title: Research model limitations
items: Research and education only — not a medical device, and not for diagnosis, treatment, or patient-specific decisions.
A 0D lumped-parameter model cannot resolve spatial blood flow, local wall stress, or three-dimensional hemodynamics.
The current exact V3 package is an experimental development default. It does not claim release readiness, simulation readiness, or clinical validation.
Parameters and outputs are approximations and require validation for each intended scientific use.

PV panes default to a responsive fixed-TBV multi-load preview. Their optional formal mode admits only full-state period-1 qualified loads and computes a method-specific SW/ESPVR/exponential-EDPVR/PE/PVA decomposition plus an LV literature-coefficient MVO₂ estimate; neither is independent physiological or clinical validation or measured oxygen consumption.

The Guyton / Starling response starts from a locally period-1-settled operating anchor with slow coronary tone frozen. Off-centre adaptive points are preview data; nonconverged or period-2 boundary points are excluded from the connected curve, and the result is not canonical qualified evidence.
standard66Items: Research and education only — not a medical device, and not for diagnosis, treatment, or patient-specific decisions.

This is a 0D lumped-parameter model. AoP is the recovered proximal aortic constitutive-port pressure and ABP is systemic arterial compartment pressure; neither is a literal catheter or cuff measurement station.
The systemic arteries do not model spatial wave travel or reflection, so waveform timing and morphology must not be interpreted as site-resolved arterial traces.
PV panes show the raw accepted exact orbit. This Surface does not provide formal PVA or Guyton / Starling analysis.
Changing heart rate starts a new exact trajectory at time zero; it does not simulate a within-run chronotropic transition.
Numerical verification and baseline characterization do not establish physiological or clinical validation.
standard67Items: Research and education only — not a medical device, and not for diagnosis, treatment, or patient-specific decisions.

This is a 0D lumped-parameter model. AoP is the recovered proximal aortic constitutive-port pressure and ABP is systemic arterial compartment pressure; neither is a literal catheter or cuff measurement station.

The Ao–SA and PA–PArt roots use algebraic flow laws retaining resistance and quadratic loss. They contain no local inertance, spatial wave travel, or reflection and must not be interpreted as site-resolved arterial traces.
PV panes show the raw accepted exact orbit. This Surface does not provide formal PVA or Guyton / Starling analysis.
Changing heart rate starts a new exact trajectory at time zero; it does not simulate a within-run chronotropic transition.
Removal of root ringing, numerical verification, and baseline characterization do not establish physiological or clinical validation.
standard68Items: Research and education only — not a medical device, and not for diagnosis, treatment, or patient-specific decisions.

This is a 0D lumped-parameter model. AoP is the aortic-root compliance-node pressure immediately downstream of the aortic valve, while ABP is systemic arterial compartment pressure. Local pressure recovery is not applied to AoP, and neither is a literal catheter or cuff measurement station.

The proximal systemic and pulmonary arteries use the source 0D momentum/compliance topology. It does not represent spatial wave travel or reflection and must not be interpreted as site-resolved arterial traces.
Formal PVA/ESPVR/EDPVR and Guyton / Starling are versioned analyses. They include previews that exclude nonconverged points and are not independent physiological or clinical validation.

Ordinary controls warm-start from the accepted state and model clock. TBV is detached-preflighted; when bounded continuation is required, it may atomically commit a later accepted boundary. Neither transition models an autonomic reflex.
Baseline mint gates, numerical verification, and morphology checks do not establish clinical normality for an individual patient or every loading condition.
standard71Items: Pressures represent lumped 0D compartments, not local jets, travelling/reflected waves, or a specific catheter or cuff station.
AoP/PAP are Ao/PA node pressures, without a displayed ZcQ addition or local pressure-recovery correction. They are not interchangeable with Doppler maximum-jet gradients.
The baseline is a local candidate. Passing numerical/construction checks does not remove reference cautions or establish clinical normality or patient prediction.
staticAnatomyItems: For research and education, not a medical device or a basis for diagnosis, treatment or patient-specific decisions.
Pressures represent 0D compartments, not local jets, wave propagation/reflection or a specific catheter or cuff location.
AoP/PAP are Ao/PA node pressures. No display-only ZcQ addition or local pressure-recovery correction is applied; they are not interchangeable with Doppler peak-jet gradients.
Baseline and chronic LV-dilated HFrEF have their own fixed anatomy and saved state. They do not simulate evolving remodeling or regional myocardial infarction.

Qualification applies to the tested preset conditions, not every control combination or clinical normality. Model and case documents describe further limits, including coronary perfusion and oxygen-consumption interpretation.
standard72Items: Pressures represent lumped 0D compartments, not local jets, travelling/reflected waves, or a specific catheter or cuff station.
AoP/PAP are Ao/PA node pressures, without a displayed ZcQ addition or local pressure-recovery correction. They are not interchangeable with Doppler maximum-jet gradients.
The baseline is a local candidate. Passing numerical/construction checks does not remove reference cautions or establish clinical normality or patient prediction.
standard70Items: Research and education only — not a medical device, and not for diagnosis, treatment, or patient-specific decisions.

This is a 0D lumped-parameter model. AoP is the aortic-root compliance-node pressure immediately downstream of the aortic valve, while ABP is systemic arterial compartment pressure. Local pressure recovery is not applied to AoP, and neither is a literal catheter or cuff measurement station.

The proximal systemic artery retains the source momentum/compliance topology; only PA–PArt uses an algebraic flow law retaining the source loss coefficients. The current quadratic coefficient is zero, so the nominal relation is linear. Spatial wave travel and reflection are not represented, so these are not site-resolved arterial traces.
Formal PVA/ESPVR/EDPVR and Guyton / Starling are versioned analyses. They include previews that exclude nonconverged points and are not independent physiological or clinical validation.

Ordinary controls warm-start from the accepted state and model clock. TBV is detached-preflighted; when bounded continuation is required, it may atomically commit a later accepted boundary. Neither transition models an autonomic reflex.
Baseline mint gates include right-heart and pulmonary-artery construction sentinels, but do not establish clinical normality for an individual patient or every loading condition.
